CD 109.title: Highway link design
CD 109.annex: Core document applies to England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales. England NAA (CD 109 - ENAA v1.1.0) adds relaxations only for modifying existing motorways, existing all-purpose dual carriageways and smart motorways (sections E/1 to E/3); it does not change the tabulated values stored here. NI NAA covers traffic signs only; Scotland and Wales NAAs state there are no alternative requirements.

CD 127.title: Cross-sections and headrooms
CD 127.annex: Core document values used. The England NAA sections E/1 and E/3 (reduced cross-sections for widening existing motorways and smart motorways) were not used and may differ from the core values.

CD 123.title: Geometric design of at-grade priority and signal-controlled junctions
CD 123.annex: No national application annex content was read for this document; the core document values are stored.

CD 116.title: Geometric design of roundabouts
CD 116.annex: Core document applies to all four nations. England NAA (CD 116 - ENAA v1.1.0) contains only road lighting content (E/1); it does not change the geometric values stored here.

CG 501.annex: Core values apply to all; climate change allowances are set by each nation's NAA. England NAA (CG 501 - ENAA v1.0.0, E/1.1 to E/1.4) uses Environment Agency allowances instead of a fixed percentage.

entries.title: Stopping sight distance, desirable minimum
entries.condition: Design speed related parameter, one value per design speed step (120, 100, 85, 70, 60, 50 km/h); rural and urban, new and improved all-purpose and motorway trunk roads. Clause 2.9: designs shall provide at least the desirable minimum values except where a relaxation is permitted

entries.verb: table value; relaxation permitted by clause 3.5

entries.title: Minimum radius with adverse camber and without transitions (V^2/R = 5)

Radii above this need no superelevation and no transitions (crossfall 2.5 %); radii below it need superelevation and transitions. Not recommended for single carriageways (Table 2.10 footnote, see Section 9)

entries.title: Minimum radius with superelevation of 2.5 % (V^2/R = 7.07)

entries.title: Minimum radius with superelevation of 3.5 % (V^2/R = 10)

entries.title: Desirable minimum radius (superelevation 5 %, V^2/R = 14.14)

entries.title: One step below desirable minimum radius (superelevation 7 %, V^2/R = 20)

entries.title: Relaxation floor: lowest design speed column usable for SSD, horizontal and vertical curvature
entries.condition: Values shall not be less than those in Table 2.10 for 50 km/h design speed regardless of permitted relaxations

entries.title: Relaxations and departures exist (structure only, logic not encoded)
entries.text: Values below the desirable minimum are permitted only as relaxations within the number of design speed steps given in Table 3.5 (stopping sight distance), Table 4.5 (horizontal curvature), Table 5.7 (crest curves) and Table 5.9 (sag curves), by road type (motorway or all-purpose) and design speed band (A or B, from Figure 2.1). Clauses 2.11 to 2.13 restrict combinations and use on immediate approaches to junctions. GG 101 gives the requirements for recording relaxations and for departures from standard; GG 101 was not fetched, so the departure procedure is not recorded here.
entries.condition: All relaxations and departures
entries.note: Band A or B is read from Figure 2.1 (a chart), which was not stored.

entries.title: Side slopes: no angle given, left to geotechnical assessment
entries.text: CD 622 gives no side slope angle or gradient. Appendix D, item D6 (recommended content of the Preliminary Sources Study Report) lists side slopes (short and long term stability) of cuttings and embankments as items of the preliminary engineering assessment for each soil or rock type and location. No numeric default exists in the fetched DMRB documents; side slopes are a geotechnical design output.
entries.condition: Cuttings and embankments

entries.title: Earthworks surface finished profile tolerance: no value given, project specific
entries.text: CC 601 clause 1.10 states that tolerances on the earthworks surface finished profile shall be as stated in CC 601/WSR/001, the works specific requirements document written for each project. No numeric tolerance is tabulated in CC 601 core text. The same section defers layout drawings or models (1.2) and verification (1.11) to the same document.
entries.condition: Earthworks surface finished profile, all earthworks
entries.verb: shall be as stated in CC 601/WSR/001 (no value)
